context.p: Shapes are graphical elements that you can add to a diagram to represent objects, processes, or other information. Whether you are working with a template or a blank canvas, you can add shapes to your diagram.
draw.io provides a variety of shapes, including basic shapes such as Square, Rectangle, and Circles, as well as more specialized shapes such as Callouts, 8 Point Stars, and Polylines.

step.cmd: In the left panel, if the shape category that contains the shape isn't expanded, click the category name. For example: General.
Repeat steps 1 and 2 to add more shapes.

taskbody.result: The selected shapes are added to the canvas.
